notes:
This update improves stitch routing in the shared engine used by the editor
and the included Auto Digitize tools.

- More consistent Satin fill patterns when changing underlay on supported
  shapes with multiple openings and turning stitch angles.
- Fewer unnecessary cuts and trims in the tested complex Satin shapes, with
  better handling of tiny travel stitches at the start of a fill.
- Improved Tatami sequencing around start/end markers and safeguards against
  connecting runs crossing the object's already stitched fill.
- Convert a filled Tatami or Satin object to **Satin outline** in Properties,
  then adjust its width. Hole boundaries become separate editable outlines.
- Short-stitch cleanup now respects the maximum stitch length after machine
  file coordinate rounding.
- Improved covered support connections, hole-bank handling and short returns.

Verification includes 696 saved-design cases, reopening, preview-cache checks,
EXP export, source/finished geometry comparisons and multiple export-grid
positions. In the focused 592-case Satin bank, planned cuts fell from 17,516 to
8,386 without additional short, duplicate or retraced needles. These are
synthetic offline results, not a general physical sew-out guarantee.

Full parity remains incomplete. Complex fills may still need extra jumps,
trims or long approaches; ordered Satin underlay and some Tatami workflows
remain unresolved. The known Knife workflow can add an extra transfer. Twelve
engine workflow checks and that editor check remain open. The newer experimental
Tatami source planner stays disabled because wider tests found regressions.
Physical sew-out validation remains deferred.

Existing users can choose **Help → Check for Updates**. Installer and portable
editions receive the same shared-engine update. Save open work before restarting.
